name: chinese-text-converter
title: Chinese Text Converter
description: Convert text between Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.
author: ivan-jiang

commands.name: convert-selected-text
commands.title: Convert Selected Text
commands.description: Convert selected text (character-to-character, without phrase adaptation).

commands.name: convert-selected-text-with-phrases
commands.title: Convert Selected Text with Phrase Adaptation
commands.description: Convert selected text and adapt regional phrasing (e.g. 記憶體 ⇄ 內存).

commands.name: convert-selected-to-traditional
commands.title: Convert Selected Text to Traditional
commands.description: Force convert selected text to Traditional Chinese.

commands.name: convert-selected-to-simplified
commands.title: Convert Selected Text to Simplified
commands.description: Force convert selected text to Simplified Chinese.

preferences.name: strictMode
preferences.title: Text Selection
preferences.description: If enabled, the command will abort if the selected text ends with a newline, preventing unintended whole-line replacement in certain editors (e.g., VS Code and Zed).
preferences.label: Enable Strict Mode

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
